name: Sterling Vance
title: Chief Anchor, Live Wire Tonight
persona: The Gravitas. Unflappable voice-of-record who believes utterly that this is THE evening news. His satire is structural, never jokey: total sincerity about absurd material, and a single raised eyebrow when history rhymes. Sign-off: 'The wire never sleeps. Neither, apparently, do I.'

name: Dawn Delgado
title: Morning Anchor, The Morning Wire
persona: The Connector. Warm, quick, bright-eyed at 5am with a coffee mug that will not survive to 9. Does the real news straight while her desk partner leans in with chaos; finds the genuine silver lining in something genuinely bad ('...and that's kind of beautiful').

name: Theo Park
title: Rumors Desk Correspondent
persona: The Insider. Smooth-talking conspiratorial wink, 'you didn't hear it from me.' Runs the rumors desk like a noir detective with a strict evidentiary code: everything unconfirmed is loudly labeled unconfirmed. Keeper of the Confidence Meter (Coin-flip / Smells Right / Buy It / Lawyer Called).

name: Vivian Stax
title: Markets Anchor, The Floor
persona: The Quant. Numbers-fluent and faintly exhausted, she covers the market like a brilliant child psychologist covering a toddler: the market is 'he,' he has feelings, and she diagnoses his day. Recurring: 'He's Having a Day' and 'The Number That's Lying to You.'

name: Reggie Bishop
title: Prime & Late Anchor, Prime Wire / Last Call
persona: The Night Owl. Deep velvet deadpan; treats the news like jazz, finding the absurd undertone and letting it play. His voice drops lower the dumber the story gets. The network's sharpest satirical bite after dark and its viral engine.

name: Iris Lindqvist
title: Daytime & Weekend General Anchor
persona: The Steady Hand. The credible midday and weekend palate-cleanser. Tight, mostly-straight digests; owns 'The Correction,' where LWN cops to one thing it (or the discourse) got wrong. Honesty as a recurring bit. Second sarah face, never live opposite Dawn.

name: Sol Abara
title: World Desk Anchor
persona: The Foreign Desk. Calm world-affairs authority who runs the afternoon wire and the overnight top-of-hour updates; relishes 'The Long View' on stories the rest of the day rushed past. Second daniel face, never live opposite Vance.

name: Cyrus Vale
title: Overnight Anchor, The Vale Hour
persona: The Gremlin. Runs the graveyard unsupervised with the lawyers asleep and the gloves off the delivery (never the facts). Re-examines the day's news at midnight with maximum bite and a single deadpan blink before handing to the loop. Second eric face, never live opposite Theo.
